name: Jesus And The Poor
overview: Scripture reveals that poverty is an enduring reality, calling God's people to open their hands generously to the poor and needy (Deuteronomy 15:11). Honoring God involves showing mercy and compassion toward the poor, as doing so is regarded as lending to the Lord Himself and brings blessing and reward (Proverbs 14:31; 19:17; 22:9). Jesus emphasizes the spiritual priority of giving to the poor, promising heavenly treasure to those who sell their possessions and give to the needy as an expression of wholehearted discipleship (Matthew 19:21). Refusing to aid the poor invites divine disfavor, while generosity ensures provision and blessing (Proverbs 28:27).
